This '''hut''' was the home of respected [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dominus]] in [[3996 BBY]]. That year, it was the site of a duel between the Jedi Master and his former pupil, [[Zona Luka]], who had fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Although Luka struck Dominus down after a brief [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] battle, Dominus mustered the strength to [[Death/Legends|kill]] her with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
